entries.text: Added the `bound_symbols` property to `Limit`, so `Limit(x + y, x, 0).bound_symbols` now gives `(x,)` instead of raising an `AttributeError`. This also makes `Limit.as_dummy()`, `Limit.dummy_eq()` and `Limit.canonical_variables` work with the limit variable.
